description: F-Secure Kernel Mode Cryptographic Driver is a FIPS 140-2 Level 1 validated software module, implemented as a 64-bit Windows export driver. When loaded into computing system memory, it resides at the kernel mode level of the Windows OS and provides a set of cryptographic services accessible by other kernel mode drivers through a C-language API.
